title: Trade District
wikitext:
[[Image:The Trade District.jpg|thumb|The Trade District]]

The '''Trade District''' is just inside [[Stormwind City]] from the main gate. It is the place in the city where you can get most goods. The Guild Master is to the left in the [[Stormwind Visitor Center|Visitors Center]] when you come in and can help you make a guild or a guild tabard. The goods that are sold in the Trade District are cheese, arcane goods and reagents, general goods, flowers, cloth/leather/mail armor, bows, guns, and clothes. The [[bank]], [[mailbox]], and [[inn]] are on the southwest side of the Trade District. The [[Flight Master|Gryphon Master]] is up a ramp on the east side. [[Patch 1.9]] added the linked [[Auction House]] in the center of the Trade District.

To get to the Trade District, you can head northeast from the [[Valley of Heroes]], southwest from [[Old Town]], southeast from the [[Cathedral Square]], or northeast from the [[Mage Quarter]].
